newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly unchanged Friday based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
"There is no one in the cotton ring, they're all trading juice," a floor source said in reference to Thursday's move lower amid brisk volume.
Nearby support for the benchmark December contract was pegged at 74.00 cents a lb, with resistance at 75.20 cents.
Thursday, most-active December closed 0.41 cent lower at 74.48 cents after trading from 74.74 to 74.35 cents. The rest finished 0.44 to 0.27 cent lower.
An estimated 3,500 lots changed hands on the day.
